transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Excuse me, I'd like to speak to the manager, please.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I'm the duty manager. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: I'm staying in room 318. We arrived yesterday evening, and there are several problems with the room.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What exactly is wrong?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: First, the air conditioning doesn't work. It's very hot at night. Second, there's a lot of noise from the street, because the window doesn't close properly. And third, the bathroom wasn't clean when we arrived. There were wet towels on the floor.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I do apologise. I'll send someone to look at the air conditioning right away. Have you already told reception?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Yes, I spoke to a man last night. He said he'd send someone, but nobody came.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I'm very sorry about that. Would you like to change rooms? We have a room on the fifth floor at the back of the hotel, which is much quieter.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: That sounds better. Is it the same price?

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: It's actually a superior room, but I'll give it to you at the same price. And it has a balcony.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Thank you. What about the bathroom? I don't want another dirty room.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I'll ask the housekeeper to check it personally before you move in. It'll be ready by two o'clock this afternoon. In the meantime, you can leave your bags with the porter.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: All right. Also, I'd like a refund for last night. We hardly slept.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I can't give you a refund, but I can offer you a free dinner in our restaurant tonight for two people. Would that be acceptable?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Hmm, that's something. Can I choose any dish from the menu?

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: Yes, any main course and a dessert, but drinks aren't included.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Okay. I'll accept that. But if the new room has any problems, I'll want to leave.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I understand completely. Here's my card. If you have any problem at all, call me directly.
